cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

mechanism: A mistakes a confident helping practice, copies it on a larger scale, and keeps increasing the sacrifice to outgive B.
confusable: D19 competes over anything; D43 answers actual favors with bigger ones. S04 needs a mistaken model, not only an excuse.
comparison: Convalescent meals and freezer space versus shift coverage and holiday travel.
seedUse: Use mutual favors and B practical constraints; remove explicit statements about being ahead.
